items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We made one record in Pittsburgh

ctx.x: Since we found out that Don Ferrara passed shall we just begin by talking a little bit about him because you worked with him quite a bit over the years.

He was quite a lovely guy who was very much into trumpet music. He really picked up the great influence of Roy Eldridge. He was very promising. We made one record in Pittsburgh; I don’t think he was on all of the tracks.
